strings.Bisect.Title: Bisect Broken Mods
strings.Bisect.Description: Rounds of half-enable + deploy to quickly find the mod causing the game crash. Uses a temporary group; the current group is never modified.
strings.Bisect.CrashHint: Note: crashes are usually caused by model/armor mods. Audio and UI mods rarely crash the game (at worst they cause display or sound issues). Suspect model mods first.
strings.Bisect.NoGameDir: Configure the game directory in Settings first.
strings.Bisect.NeedTwoEnabled: The current group needs at least 2 enabled mods to run a bisect.
strings.Bisect.StartConfirmMessage:
Note: crashes are usually caused by model/armor mods; audio and UI mods rarely crash the game (at worst they cause display or sound issues). Suspect model mods first.

A temporary group "{name}" will be created, the current enabled state (including option toggles) will be copied, and the app will switch to it. The original group stays untouched. Start now?
strings.Bisect.SingleVerifyMessage:
Converged to the last candidate "{name}"; deploying it alone for verification:

The game was launched automatically, verify whether it crashes, then choose a result.
If it crashes alone, it is confirmed as the problem mod; if it does not crash, the mod itself is fine (the crash may be caused by a combination of mods).
strings.Bisect.CanceledMessage: Bisect canceled: temporary group removed, original group untouched.
strings.Bisect.ContinueQuestion:
Located suspect mod "{name}" and disabled it in the temporary group.

Continue bisecting the remaining {count} mod(s)?
strings.Bisect.SummaryMessage:
Ran {rounds} round(s) and located {count} suspect mod(s):
{names}

They have been disabled in the original group automatically.
Note: if a suspect is an audio/UI mod, it may not be the real cause; check model mods first.
strings.Bisect.SummaryNone: No clear suspect found. If the game still crashes, check model/armor mods first or run the bisect again.
strings.Bisect.GameRunningMessage:
The game is running; deployed mod patches will not take effect while it is open.
The game will be closed automatically before deploying. Close it and continue? Choosing "No" cancels the bisect.
strings.Bisect.AbortConfirm: Aborting switches back to the original group and deletes the temporary group (the original group is not affected). Abort now?

strings.VersionCheckDisclaimer.Title: Mod repair risk and usage notice
strings.VersionCheckDisclaimer.Message:
Mod repair rebuilds game resource structures, and automatic decisions cannot be guaranteed to work for every mod. A repaired mod may have invisible models, crash the equipment screen or game, or contain damaged files. HD2MM attempts to create backups, but you should also retain the original mod before repairing it.

Repaired mods are for your personal use only. Do not upload, share, resell, or redistribute them in any form. Rights to models, textures, and other assets remain with their original authors.

Selecting Confirm means that you understand and accept these risks and restrictions. This notice will not be shown again after acceptance.
